Missing field must be null, never guessed.
Output only the JSON object, no prose.
Amounts use Turkish formatting in source (1.234,56) and must become numbers.

cases.prompt: react'te useEffect neden iki kere çalışıyor
cases.intent: Explain why useEffect runs twice and what to do about it.
facts: React 19 with Vite in development mode.
StrictMode is on in main.tsx.

cases.prompt: login sayfasına beni hatırla kutusu ekle
cases.intent: Add a 'remember me' checkbox to the login page with correct session behavior.
facts: Next.js 15 App Router with Auth.js (NextAuth v5), credentials provider.
Checked: session lasts 30 days. Unchecked: session ends when the browser closes.
Playwright e2e tests exist under e2e/; they must keep passing.
UI text is Turkish: 'Beni hatırla'.
mustAsk: what remember-me should change (session duration or behavior)

bu metni düzelt ama anlamını değiştirme:

cases.prompt: müşteri destek botu için system prompt yaz, iade sorularına cevap versin
cases.intent: A system prompt for a returns-support chatbot that applies the store's policy correctly.
facts: Store: Lumo Home (home textiles, online).
Returns within 14 days of delivery, only unopened products.
Defective products: 2-year warranty, always accepted.
Exceptions or angry customers: hand off to a human via the phrase 'Sizi bir temsilcimize aktarıyorum'.
Reply in Turkish, friendly, short.
